Wol-stat of the day:
Allen Graves had 4 offensive rebounds in his first NBA game.
The only Raptors rookie to pull down more? 
Jonas Valanciunas had 6 in his debut 2012.
"That's something that I know I can impact right away," Graves told us afterward.
